explanation: The nonce check in verify rejects a token whose nonce is already in seen. Removing it would let a token be reused in a replay attack. #123 is an issue reference.
Call ensure_key_salt before constructing KeyManager, because initialization depends on the salt. If ensuring the salt fails, startup must abort.
Before allocating buf with topN elements, keep topN at or below maxSimpleTopN so the resulting slice stays at or below 1 MiB. maxSimpleTopN is the named limit.
If meta.abi_version is missing, the mapping must produce None. Treating a missing value as the current ABI would be unsafe. #1784 is an issue reference.

TLP reads /etc/tlp.conf after files matching /etc/tlp.d/*.conf, so values in the main file override the drop-in written at /etc/tlp.d/90-power.conf. Those paths are configuration files and the drop-in pattern.

The set_key call relies on TLP version 1.10 or later. _AC, _BAT and _SAV are TLP profile suffixes; the key being set uses _BAT. Leaving the corresponding _AC setting unset lets GNOME’s Performance toggle keep working.
On a JsonException, this catch block returns null so the caller can log the parse warning. Logging is the caller’s responsibility.

When AllowedTools is set, RemoveSkipPermissions must remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from args. That flag bypasses the --allowedTools restriction. AllowedTools is the configured tool set; the two dashed names are command-line flags.

For the dead-code decision in thunk_is_dead, consult the verdict table in the is_definitely_dead_code symbol at rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs. The path identifies the source file and the text after the colon identifies the symbol.
repos_skipped is currently initialized to zero; a future change should calculate it from the domains-to-repositories mapping. #874 is the issue reference for that work.
The index.regex_query call uses a linear-time DFA for regex matching, so the query does not incur regex backtracking. regex_query is the method whose performance behavior matters here.

The token-family table schema created here must stay in sync with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py. The path names the source file and the text after the colon names the method.
MAX_BATCH is 500 because the vendor’s batch API accepts no more than 500 items per request. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor-api documentation.

Keep these Status values in sync with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Their iota order assigns stored integer values, so reordering Pending, Running or Done would change what existing stored integers mean. #88 is an issue reference.
The index must list tenant_id first and created_at second to match the orders_by_tenant query. orders_by_tenant is the named query that depends on this column order.
TList.Add must maintain FCount at or below Length(FItems), the number of available item slots. Grow is the routine responsible for preserving that bound when capacity increases.
In close, call _flush before closing _sink: closing discards _buf, so reversing the order could lose buffered data. _flush, _sink and _buf are the methods or fields involved.

userPath comes from a request. Resolve and normalize it under workspaceRoot, and reject any .. path that escapes that root. workspaceRoot is the permitted directory; .. is the parent-directory path component.
Drain ring before freeing buf. Otherwise the interrupt handler could use buf after it has been freed. ring_drain is the drain operation, and #2201 is an issue reference.

items.reserve(n) allocates capacity up front so ingest needs one allocation; repeated push_back growth accounted for 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
The SQL Server MERGE on dbo.Accounts requires HOLDLOCK to prevent concurrent upserts from racing. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency section of the referenced MERGE documentation.
PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION makes the audit write independent of the caller’s transaction, so its row survives if the caller rolls back.

SQLite’s ALTER TABLE cannot drop the constraint needed by this change, so the migration creates a replacement table, leases_new, as part of rebuilding the table. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the relevant SQLite ALTER TABLE documentation section.
The loop scans every five seconds because NFS mounts do not emit the inotify events this code would need. done.wait(5) supplies the five-second polling interval.
Keep the awaited run(job) calls in a for...of loop. Putting await inside forEach would let asynchronous errors escape the surrounding try/catch.
Every frame returned by read_frame must have a Vec<u8> length at or below MAX_FRAME. The decoder enforces that bound by rejecting larger frames; MAX_FRAME is the named size limit.
Register drainHook with addShutdownHook before calling pool.start(). The hook drains the pool when the process receives SIGTERM.

Move backoff’s fixed two-second retry policy into configuration. The work is done when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration; the path identifies the file and Default identifies the symbol.
For the complete set of transitions among LeaseState values such as Active, Released and Stale, consult issue #412.

Pass TOKEN to tool login through stdin using --token-stdin. Never put the token in command-line arguments, because ps exposes those arguments to other users. TOKEN is the shell variable holding the credential.
Create the app_reader database role before granting it SELECT access. Migration 042 depends on that role already existing; app_reader is the role name and 042 identifies the migration.

Stripe may retry a webhook for three days, so on_event must handle repeated delivery without duplicating its effects. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the webhook-retries section of the Stripe documentation.

Compare the received MAC sig with expected using hmac.Equal, whose comparison is constant time. Using == could reveal information through timing differences. hmac.Equal is the required comparison function.
Build CodeGraph from facts once per index, at a cost proportional to the number of edges. Do not rebuild it for each query. CodeGraph::build is the graph construction method.
Changing the packed layout of TCustomerRec would make existing saved .dat files incompatible. If its layout changes, bump FILE_VERSION so the saved-file format version reflects that change.
Change this MSG_MAX definition together with MSG_MAX_WIRE in proto/messages.h. They are coupled size limits; the path identifies the header containing the other symbol.
handler relies on authMiddleware having run first and established a non-null session.userId. authMiddleware is the middleware that guarantees this field is present.
The cache block is synchronized because checking for a value and inserting it must be one atomic operation. Using ConcurrentHashMap alone would not make that combined check-then-put operation atomic.

raw is a user-provided repository alias. validate_alias must check it against the registry before the alias is used in a path join, preventing an unsafe path from being constructed. #1996 is an issue reference.
Payments.Amount must be nonnegative. Refunds are represented as separate rows whose Kind is 'R', rather than as negative amounts in this INSERT. Amount and Kind are the table columns involved.
Set stop_ to true before calling worker_.join(). Otherwise the worker may keep running and join may wait forever. stop_ is the stop flag and worker_ is the thread being joined.
This limiter is intended to respect the GitHub API allowance of 5,000 requests per hour for each token. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the rate-limits section of the GitHub REST documentation.

Stop the cidx service before installing the replacement binary at /usr/local/bin/cidx. Replacing the binary while it is running could fail with “Text file busy”; the path is the installed binary’s location.
Do not share _lease across jobs belonging to different users: its credentials could leak between them. _lease is the CredentialLease field, and #77 is an issue reference.

Keep ids at 999 entries or fewer when binding them to this DELETE statement, because the stated SQLite bound-variable limit applies per statement. ids supplies the bound values, and marks supplies their placeholders.
If cgroup.create(limit) fails, log a warning and let the job continue. A bad memory estimate must reduce containment rather than abort the job; cgroup.create is the containment setup call.
Remove the legacy /v1/jobs route registered here. /v1 is the old API prefix, and #530 is the issue reference for the removal.
Consult the session-model section at doc:adr-007#session-model for the reason SessionRegistry keeps sessions per tab. SessionRegistry is the class this design decision applies to.

This partial index covers only leases where released_at IS NULL, making active-lease lookups by credential_id 30 times faster according to the measured result. The WHERE clause defines which rows the index contains.
Keep EVENT_TYPES synchronized with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and with docs/events.md. The first path identifies the label mapping; the second is the events documentation.
